input_yaml.description: Absolute path to a Boltz-format YAML describing protein chain(s) + a small-molecule ligand and the affinity property to score. Affinity binder must be a ligand chain, not a protein/RNA/DNA chain. Mutually exclusive with `sequences` and `candidates`.

sequences.description: Inline list of typed inputs Boltz accepts (protein/rna/dna/ligand entities). Mutually exclusive with `input_yaml`.

type.description: Entity type: protein/rna/dna for biopolymers (use `sequence`); ligand for small molecules (use `smiles` or `ccd`).

id.description: Chain identifier or list of identifiers for this entity. Strings for a single chain; arrays for multi-copy entities sharing the same sequence/structure.

sequence.description: Amino-acid (proteins) or nucleotide (rna/dna) sequence for the entity. Ignored for ligand entries.

smiles.description: SMILES string for a ligand entity. Mutually exclusive with `ccd` within the same entry.

ccd.description: PDB CCD (Chemical Component Dictionary) code for a known ligand. Use instead of `smiles` for canonical small molecules.

msa.description: Optional path to a precomputed multiple-sequence alignment (a3m) for this protein chain.

binder.description: Mark this entity as the binder for affinity scoring (Boltz routes the affinity head to the chain flagged binder=true).

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream small-molecule ligand workflow. Translates to `sequences` when neither `input_yaml` nor `sequences` is given. Protein-protein binder candidates are not valid affinity inputs for Boltz2.

binder_chain.description: Chain id of the small-molecule ligand whose affinity is scored. Required when using `sequences`; ignored when `input_yaml` already declares a `properties.affinity` block. Protein/RNA/DNA binder chains are rejected.

seeds.description: List of integer RNG seeds. Boltz runs one prediction per seed; multiple seeds yield diversity for ensemble downstream scoring.

recycling_steps.description: Number of structure-prediction recycling iterations (Boltz `--recycling_steps`). Higher values improve accuracy with diminishing returns; 3 is the typical default.

sampling_steps.description: Diffusion sampling steps used during structure inference. Larger values improve structural quality at the cost of runtime.

diffusion_samples.description: Number of independent diffusion samples drawn per seed during structure inference. Increase for ensemble structures.

sampling_steps_affinity.description: Diffusion sampling steps used by the affinity prediction head. Independent from the structure-head `sampling_steps`.

diffusion_samples_affinity.description: Number of diffusion samples for the affinity head per seed. Increasing reduces stochastic noise in the predicted affinity.

use_msa.description: Enable multiple-sequence-alignment features for the protein chain(s). MSAs improve structural accuracy but require either a pre-built MSA or a remote ColabFold call.

msa_backend.description: MSA backend policy. With `use_msa=true`, `auto` uses a prepared MSA if present and otherwise falls back to the remote ColabFold server; `none` disables MSA; `remote` always calls the remote MSA server.

affinity_mw_correction.description: Apply a molecular-weight correction to the predicted affinity (Boltz `affinity_mw_correction`). Useful when comparing across ligands of different sizes.
